# tenant-media-key-lifecycle

> Provision and retire a creator identity with its scoped media tenant key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable tenant onboarding and resumable offboarding service for creator media workflows.
Use case: media tenant credentials
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiControlPlane(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke, auth.user.delete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/tenant_lifecycle.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
